newsitem.title: USA: SS&C Technologies faces class-action suit.
newsitem.headline: SS&C Technologies faces class-action suit.

text.p: The law firm of Rabin & Peckel LLP said on Thursday it commenced a class-action lawsuit against SS&C Technologies Inc alleging securities law violations in connection with an initial public offering.
The suit alleges that SS&C, some of its directors and officers and the lead underwriters of its May 1996 offering of issued a false registration statement and prospectus.
SS&C said in response that it has meritorious defenses and intends to defend the lawsuit vigorously.

The suit alleges that rather than determining a price based on market conditions, past and projected financial results and the demand for similar securities, the qualified independent underwiter recommended a price based on nothing other than the public demand for the stock.
The suit was filed on behalf of people who bought SS&C stock during the period from May 31, 1996 through July 31 1996.
SS&C shares were trading at 5-3/16 on Thursday, down 3/16. Their 52-week high was 23-1/2.
SS&C, of Bloomfield, Conn., provides client/server-based software products and related services.
